Learners round multi-digit whole numbers to two or three significant figures.

Targets truncation and confusion between significant figures and decimal places.

prtincorrect.text: Start counting significant figures at the first non-zero digit.

truefeedback.text:
You kept the requested significant digits, but it looks like you truncated instead of rounding.

Look at the next digit. If it is \(5\) or greater, increase the last retained significant digit by \(1\).

node.description: Checks for confusion between significant figures and decimal places.

truefeedback.text:
Significant figures are not the same as decimal places.

Start counting from the first non-zero digit, then round after the required number of significant figures.

falsefeedback.text: Identify the first non-zero digit and count significant figures from there.

qtest.description: Teacher answer should receive full credit.
Decimal-place confusion should receive zero credit.
